name: Dr.Jit Optimizations
definition: A set of global optimizations performed by Dr.Jit during tracing to improve code generation, specifically addressing the opaque boundary of dynamic dispatch that breaks interprocedural optimizations in LLVM/OptiX.
summary: Dr.Jit Optimizations are global transformations that improve volume rendering performance by tracing and deduplicating polymorphic code, tailored for PBDR arithmetic rather than ML-centric tensorial methods.
